title: SPORES Studio Mixer
tagline: A “studio” with the SPORES as the center controller. The app takes in 2 songs, 3 stems to loop, and artwork for the skin. After remixing you can mint.
description:
We like the feeling you get when combining two songs together. DJ’ing in general is based off that exact feeling. With web3 there’s a whole universe of songs to play with. 
1. You can input a contract (or by default it’s just http://catalog.works)
2. Users given a list of all the songs from that contract (can use zora api to grab all this info)
3. Clicking on a song queues it into the Spore player

Thought it would be dope to have two circles (one on each side of the spore player), spinning. Sorta representing the 2 songs that are currently being mixed— like 2 turn tables

Bringing up a whole new dynamic/way to think about it we minted a few sounds as "layers" that could mix together and be “juiced” by other sounds. You can mix 2 songs directly w/ the cross-fader/alternate slider but then you have the "juice samples" which is basically a list of loops you can alternate between. If you have an element that is sort of a loop (like maybe drums), you could throw it in there and see how it effects that SPORES.

We limited it (for the hackathon) to a works submitted by Nate Fox, although he submitted over 20 we only used a small sample here.
